{{Combat}} [[Zun'watha]] |affiliation = [[Wildhammer clan]], [[Silvermoon Remnant]], [[Revantusk tribe]], [[Vilebranch tribe]], [[Witherbark tribe]], [[Green dragonflight]] |faffiliation = [[Old Horde]] }} The '''Hinterlands''', located in the Northern part of the [[Eastern Kingdoms]], are probably most notable for the [[Wildhammer dwarf|Wildhammer dwarves]] who make their residence at [[Aerie Peak]] in the west. The Wildhammers have always been staunch allies of the [[Alliance]]. It is from the Hinterlands that these dwarves find and tame their world-renowned [[gryphon]]s. The [[Razorbeak Gryphon|Razorbeak gryphon]]s roam wild in this region. Also in the Hinterlands is one of the last remaining settlements of the [[High elf|high elves]] in Lordaeron at the [[Quel'Danil Lodge]]. The Hinterlands are also home to a large population of [[forest troll]]s, which are divided into three separate tribes. The [[Revantusk tribe]] is the only one of the three that has declared sides in the Horde-Alliance conflict and support Warchief [[Thrall]] of the [[Horde]]. The [[Vilebranch]] tribe holds residence in the massive troll city of [[Jintha'Alor]] as well as the [[Altar of Zul]] while the [[Witherbark tribe]] holds the smallest influence, hailing from the temples of [[Shadra'Alor]]. In the northern part of the region is the ancient, massive tree, [[Seradane]] where the agents of the [[Green dragonflight]] have been corrupted. A massive portal on the side of the tree connects the servants of the [[Aspect]] [[Ysera]] to her own realm, the [[Emerald Dream]]. ==Geography== While there are no instanced dungeons in the Hinterlands, the zone is notable for its huge outdoor micro dungeon, [[Jintha'Alor]]. The Hinterlands are the location of [[Seradane]], one of the four [[Great Tree]]s leading to the [[Emerald Dream]] and guarded by the four Emerald Dragons. The three others are in [[Ashenvale]], [[Duskwood]], and [[Feralas]]. === Maps and subregions === [[File:WorldMap-Hinterlands.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Map of the Hinterlands]] WorldMap-Hinterlands-old2.jpg|The Hinterlands prior to [[patch 1.16.0]].
